economics: fx 3.3; VAT 18%; card 2% + ₪1.2; returns 8% of net; packaging 0; shipping for qty q = unit + (q-1) x max(0, unit-3.72); landed = (cost + shipping) x 3.3; margin = contribution / net, before CAC. Cheapest line to Israel first; cheapest within 20 days (max days <= 20) reported separately. CJ estimates by weight: CJPacket Eub to IL ~ $3.72 + $12.6/kg (fitted on 20 quotes), marked ship_estimated.
retail_rule: retail_ils = the losing product's Israeli-value price (pricing/other-rooms-2026-10-11.json) unless retail_note_he gives a re-derived price for a different class, size or a set.
